scope: Additive TH18 regular Witch direct-baseline integration. The required Witch Skeleton is kept inventory-visible but unmaterialized until a reproducible stat and summoning contract is available.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell identifies regular Witch level 8 as Town Hall 18 content, while the numeric parent table remains the pinned secondary payload.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: The release note establishes Witch level 8 at Town Hall 18, but does not publish numerical parent values or any Witch Skeleton stat, count, lifetime, level mapping, summon interval, first-summon delay, cap, spawn geometry or targeting contract.

sources.title: Home Village Witch structured troop record
sources.limitations: The pinned public payload supplies the L1-L8 parent values, level requirements, range, cadence, movement, housing and target type. It gives no standalone Witch Skeleton record or deterministic summoning behavior.

sources.title: Witch
sources.limitations: The current public page was reviewed for the required Skeleton relationship. It does not provide a version-pinned Witch Skeleton table or a complete deterministic summoning lifecycle suitable for GameData.

support.note: Core materializes the pinned L1-L8 direct parent baseline. Witch Skeleton summoning stays disabled because no source-backed child values or deterministic lifecycle is available.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L8 parent with no Core identifier or adapter route.
changed_values.replacement: The source-backed L1-L8 parent materializes through the shared Core path with its published direct attack, range, cadence, movement, housing and target type.
changed_values.justification: The parent has a complete pinned public level table and Supercell confirms the Town Hall 18 level. Its child behavior remains excluded from the implemented baseline until it can be modeled without guessing.

changed_values.previous_state: Not represented in the permanent spawned-subunit inventory.
changed_values.replacement: Recorded as a required but unmaterializable Witch child in the scope inventory.
changed_values.justification: The parent-child relationship is public, but the consulted sources do not provide enough immutable child data or lifecycle detail to create a deterministic entity.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source provides Witch Skeleton hitpoints, damage, cadence, range, speed, target type, altitude, housing, level mapping, count, lifetime, cap, spawn interval, first-summon delay, spawn geometry, target selection, retargeting, trap interaction or asset path for the current TH18 version.
No public source gives the regular Witch splash radius or projectile speed. Core preserves the classified attack as a direct primary-target baseline and does not claim area or travel fidelity.
The parent visual tiers are retained from the pinned public payload, but source verification of sprite placement, scaling and animation is incomplete.
conclusion: Regular Witch L1-L8 is executable through the shared Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL path as a direct parent baseline. Witch Skeleton summoning, area damage, projectile timing and visual fidelity remain explicitly partial.
